scripts.check: bun run verify:generated && bun run test:core && bun build ./app.js --target=browser --outdir=/tmp/argiope-palettes-check
scripts.check:editors: bun run check && bun run verify:neovim && bun run verify:helix && bun run verify:textmate && bun run verify:shiki-preview && bun run test:neovim && bun run test:textmate
scripts.verify:generated: bun run build:neovim && bun run build:helix && bun run build:textmate && git diff --exit-code -- dist/argiope-themes.lua dist/helix dist/textmate
scripts.verify:helix: bun run sync:helix && git -C editors/helix diff --exit-code -- themes runtime/queries languages.toml
scripts.verify:neovim: bun run sync:neovim && git -C editors/neovim diff --exit-code -- lua/argiope/generated/themes.lua
scripts.verify:textmate: bun run sync:textmate && git -C editors/textmate diff --exit-code -- syntaxes themes
scripts.verify:shiki-preview: bun run preview:shiki && git diff --exit-code -- docs/shiki-preview.html
